senses.gloss:
mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं)
Who or what does, makes or causes, as किङ्करः A servant, who does any thing; भयङ्करः frightful, what causes fear; उपकरः who gives aid; अपकरः who does ill, &c.
m. (रः)
1 A ray of light, a sun or moonbeam.
2 Royal revenue, toll, tax, impost, &c.
3 The hand.
4 Hail.
5 An elephant's trunk.
E.
कृञ् to do, &c. ट or अप् aff.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Who or what does any act, (but used chiefly in composition with other words); the agent, a maker or doer; as कुम्भकार a potter, a maker of earthen vessels. स्वर्णकार a goldsmith, &c.
m. (-रः)
1 Act, action.
2 Killing, slaughter.
3 Certainty.
4 Effort, exertion.
5 Religious austerity.
6 A heap of snow, or a mountain covered with it.
7 Tax, toll, royal revenue.
8 A master, a lord.
f. (-रा)
1 A prison.
2 Binding, confinement.
3 A female messenger.
4 The part of a lute below the neck.
5 A female worker in gold, (हेमकारिका?)
6 Pain, affliction.
E.
कृञ् to make, to do, with घञ् or अण् affix, in the latter case the fem. affix is ङीष्.

mf. (-कः-का)
Hail.
mn. (-कः-कं)
1 The water pot of the student or ascetic.
2 The shell of the cocoanut hollowed to form a vessel.
m. (-कः)
1 The pomegranate tree.
2 Toll, tax.
3 A particular sort of bird.
4 A plant, (Galedupa arborea, &c.) see करञ्च.
5 A tree, (Butea frondosa.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding, or कृ to injure, &c. and वुन् aff.

mfn. (-रकः-रिका-रकं)
An agent, acting, doing, who or what does, acts, makes, &c.
m. (-कः)
A noun of action.
n. (-कं)
1 Action, especially in grammar.
2 That part of grammar comprising all nouns which imply the agent, object, instrument, &c. or any thing except the simple and radical idea; it also includes the use and government of the cases or syntax.
E.
कृञ् to do, and ण्वुल् affix of agency.

m. (-कः)
The finger nail. कर the hand, and कण्ठक a thorn.

n. (-लं)
The hand, especially of a lover, a mistress, &c.
E.
कर, and कमल a lotus; also similar compounds, as करपद्मं, करपङ्कज, करपल्लव, &c.

m. (-शः)
The hand hollowed to receive water.
E.
कर, and कलश a ewer.

m. (-म्भाः)
The cocoanut tree, (Cocos nucifera.)
E.
करक the shell, and अम्भस् the water, the nut containing a serous fluid.

n. (-लं)
A finger.
E.
कर, and कुद्मल a bud.

m. (-षः)
The hollow of the hand.
E.
कर, and कोष receptacle.

m. (-हः)
1 Marriage.
2 Levying or gathering a tax.
3 A tax gatherer.
4 Taking the hand.
E.
कर, and ग्रह taking: one part of the ceremony of marriage is the placing of the right hand of the bride with the palm uppermost, in the right hand of the bridegroom; also करग्राह.

n. (-णं)
1 Levying or gathering a tax.
2 Taking the hand.
3 Marriage.
E.
कर, and ग्रहण taking.

mfn. (-ही-हिणी-हि)
1 Levying a tax.
2 Taking the hand.
E.
कर, and ग्राहिन् who takes.

m. (-णः)
The churning stick.
n. (-णं)
Rubbing the hands together.
E.
कर the hand, and घर्षण rubbing.

m. (-र्षी)
The churning stick.
E.
कर the hand, घृष to rub, णिनि aff.

m. (-ङ्कः)
1 The head.
2 A cocoanut hollowed so as to form a cup or vessel.
3 Any bone of the body.
4 A kind of sugar cane.
E.
कृ to send or throw, &c. अंक aff.

m. (-लिः)
A sort of sugar cane.

n. (-णं)
A market or fair.
E.
कर tax, and गण collection, &c.

m. (-दः)
The teak tree.
E.
कर, and च्छद a leaf.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Produced in or from a hand, a ray, &c.
m. (-जः)
1 A finger nail.
2 The name of a timber tree, commonly Karanja, (Galendupa arborea, Rox.)
n. (-जं)
A perfume, commonly Nakhi, resembling a nail in appearance.
E.
कर the hand, and ज produced; or कं pleasure, रञ्ज to colour, &c. अच affix: see the next.

mfn. (-जः-जी-जं)
Of or relating to the finger nail.
m. (-जः)
A young elephant.
E.
करज a nail, &c. अण् aff.

n. (-लं)
A pencil of rays, a stream of light.
E.
कर, and जाल multitude.

m. (-ञ्जः)
The name of a plant, commonly Karanja, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.)
E.
क water, and रञ्ज to colour, अच् affix: see करज.

m. (-कः)
1 Karanja: see the preceding.
2 Another plant, (Verbesina scandens, Rox.) see भृङ्गराज.
E.
कन् added to the foregoing.

m. (-टः)
1 A crow.
2 An elephant's cheek.
3 Safflower or carthamus.
4 A man of a low or degraded profession.
5 The first Śrāddha or ceremony performed in honour of a deceased relation.
6 An atheist, an unbeliever, an oppugner of the doctrines of the Vedas.
7 A musical instrument, (Castanets?)
f. (-टा)
A cow difficult to be milked.
E.
क pleasure, &c. रट to sound, and अच् affix; or कृ to do, and अटन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A crow.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-टी)
An elephant.
E.
करट and इनि aff.

m. (-टुः)
The numidian crane.
E.
कर् for कुत् bad, अट to go, and डु aff.

n. (-णं)
1 An instrument or means of action.
2 Making, doing.
3 Action, act.
4 Cause, motive.
5 Business, occupation, as trade, &c.
6 An organ of sense.
7 The body.
8 The mind or heart.
9 A field.
10 Grain.
11 The posture, abstinence, &c. of an ascetic.
12 Copulation, (seu modus coeundi.)
13 The usage or practice of the writer caste.
14 Acting, dramatic action.
15 Song, singing.
16 The particular business of any tribe or cast.
17 Plaistering, spreading any thing with the hand.
18 A Karaṇa, an astrological division of time; the Karaṇas are eleven: 7 moveable and 4 fixed, and two are equal to a lunar day; or the time during which the moon's motion from the sun amounts to 6°.
19 (In grammar) The instrumental case, or noun in that case.
m. (-णः)
A man of a mixed class, the son of a Śūdra woman by a Vaiśya; or, according to some, of an outcast Kṣetriya, by a Kṣetriya female; the occupation of this class is writing, accounts, &c. a writer, a scribe.
f. (-णी)
1 A woman of the same caste.
2 (In arithmetic, &c.) A surd or irrational quantity.
E.
कृ to do, to act, &c. ल्युट् aff.

n. (-णं)
1 Cause, motive, origin, principle: in logic, cause is of three kinds; Samavāyi, inherent or direct; Asamavāyi, proximate or indirect; and Nimitta, instrumental or incidental.
2 Action, agency.
3 Killing, injuring.
4 An organ of sense.
5 An instrument or means.
6 An element, elementary matter.
7 A deity, as the remote or proximate cause of creation.
8 A number of scribes.
9 A kind of musical instrument.
10 A sort of song, &c. see करण.
11 The origin of a story (of a play or poem.)
f. (-णा)
1 Pain, agony.
2 Casting into hell.
3 An astronomical period.
E.
कृञ् to do or act, in the causal form, and युच् or ल्युट् affix, or करण and अण् added.

n. (-णं)
The head.
E.
करण an organ of sense, and त्राण preserving.

n. (-त्वं)
Instrumentality, mediate agency.
E.
त्व added to करण.

n. (-त्वं)
Causality, causation.
E.
त्व added to कारण, and त्व affix, or with तल्, कारणता.

m. (-मः)
Suppression or restraint of the organs of sense.
E.
करण, and नियम restraint.

f. (-णिः)
Doing, making, effecting.
E.
कृ to do, अनि affix; also with कन added करणिका.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
To be done or made.
E.
कृ to do, अनीयर् aff.

f. (-ता)
An adopted daughter.

m. (-ण्डः)
1 A basket or covered box of bamboo wicker work.
2 A bee-hive, a honey-comb.
3 A sword.
4 A sort of duck.
5 An aquatic weed, (Vallisneria.)
E.
कृ to do, अण्डन् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ण्डी)
A fish in general.
E.
करण्ड Vallisneria, and इनि aff.

n. (-लं)
The palm of the hand.
E.
कर, and तल lower part.

nf. (-लं-ली)
1 A musical instrument, a cymbal.
2 Beating time by clapping the hands.
E.
कर the hand, ताल musical time, and ङीष् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Held in the hand.
E.
करतल, and धृत held.

mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं)
Held in the hand, what is in or under the hand.
E.
करतल, and स्थ what is.

f. (-या)
The Karatoyā river, a river in the north-east of Bengal.
E.
कर the hand, and तोय water: at the wedding of ŚIVA and PĀRVATĪ, the water which had been poured into the hand of the former, constituted, upon its being thrown on the ground, the source of this river.

mfn. (-दः-दा-दं)
1 Subject to tax or duty.
2 Tributary.
3 Who gives his hand, &c.
E.
कर, and द who gives.

mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं)
Handy, dexterous, ready. कर, and दक्ष clever.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Subjugated, made tributary.
E.
करद, and कृत made with च्चि augment.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Held, supported by the hand.
E.
कर, and धृत held.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Held in the hand.
E.
कर, and निहित placed.

n. (-त्रं)
1 A saw.
2 Splashing water about while bathing, playing or gamboling in water.
E.
कर, and पत्र a leaf; being in the hand as a leaf.

n. (-त्रं)
1 The hand hollowed so as to hold any thing.
2 The throwing of water in sport.
E.
कर, and पात्र a cup.

m. (-वान्)
The palmyra tree, (Borassus flabelliformis.)
E.
करपत्र a saw, and मतुप् affix, the spatha being compared to a saw.

f. (-का)
Playing with water, gamboling in it, splashing it about; also करपत्र, करपात्र and करपत्रिक.

m. (-र्णः)
A species of castor oil tree.
E.
कर, and पर्ण a leaf.

m. (-वः)
A finger.
E.
कर, and पल्लव a shoot.

(-लः)
A sword, a scymitar.
E.
कर the hand, and पल protecting, or with बल to be strong, करबाल.

f. (-का)
1 A cudgel, a short club or wooden sword.
2 A sword or one edged knife.
E.
कर the hand, पाल to nourish, ण्वुल् affix, and the fem. termination.

m. (-टं)
Joining the palms of the hands to shew respect.
2 The hands joined and hollowed to receive anything.
E.
कर, and पुट् a bag.

n. (-ष्ठं)
Back of the hand.
E.
कर, and पृष्ठ back.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 To be held, to be taken hold of.
2 To be collected by taxes.
E.
कर, and प्रचेय to be accumulated.

mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं)
Held in hand, got, secured.
E.
कर, and प्राप्त obtained.

n. (-लः)
1 A finger nail.
2 A sword, a scymitar: see करपाल.

f. (-का)
A small sword, &c. see करपालिका.

m. (-भः)
1 The metacarpus, the hand from the wrist to the root of the fingers.
2 A young camel or any young animal.
3 A young elephant.
4 A perfume, commonly Nakhi.
f. (-भी)
A she camel.
E.
कृ to reject, अभच Uṇādi affix: see कलभ.

f. (-या)
A plant, a sort of Hedysarum.
E.
करभ, and प्रिय fond of; folder for camels.

m. (-भी)
An elephant.
E.
करभ and इनि aff.

m. (-रः)
A lion.
E.
करभ a young animal, and ईर who destroys.

n. (-णं)
A bracelet, an ornament worn round the wrist.
E.
कर the hand, and भूषण an ornament.

m. (-ट्टः)
The betel nut tree: see गुवका.

m. (-री)
A prisoner, a captive.

m. (-र्द्दः)
A small tree bearing an acid fruit, commonly Karonda or Karinda, (Carissa carondas.)
E.
कर the hand, and मृद to destroy, अण् affix; what is plucked by the hand; also with कन् affix, करमर्द्दक and fem. with ङीष् affix करमर्द्दी.

करामर्द्द^1
m. (-र्द्दः)
A fruit tree, (Carissa carondas): see करमर्द्द.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260425. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/158.

m. (-कः)
See the preceding.

m. (-लः)
Smoke, probably an error or corruption for खतमाल.

f. (-ला)
The hand used as a rosary, the joints of the fingers corresponding to the beads.
E.
कर, and माला a rosary.

n. (-क्तं)
A missile weapon, but thrown by the hand, a dart, a javelin, &c.
E.
कर, and मुक्त released.

m. (-वः)
A finger.
E.
कर and अग्र to the point, पल्लव a shoot.

mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
1 Mixed, intermingled.
2 Set, inlaid.
m. (-म्बः)
Flour or meal mixed with curds: see करम्भ.
E.
कृ to do, अम्बच् Uṇādi aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Intermingled, mixed, blended, &c.
2 Pounded, reduced to grains or dust.
2 Set, inlaid.
E.
करम्ब and इतच् aff.

m. (-म्भः)
A cake, flour or meal mixed with curds.
E.
क water, and रभि to send, &c. अच् affix, also with कन् added करम्भक; also with रवि to sound, &c. करम्ब, &c. as above.

f. (-म्भा)
A plant bearing a fragrant seed, commonly Priyangu.
E.
का for कु bad, आरम्भ beginning; very diminutive while young.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
Stopped by the hand, held tight or fast.
E.
कर, and रुद्व stopped.

m. (-हः)
A finger nail.
E.
कर the hand, and रुह to grow, to rise, affix क.

m. (-र्द्धिः)
A small musical instrument used for marking time, (a castanet,) or clapping the hands together for that purpose.
E.
कर the hand, ऋद्धि property.

f. (-का)
A small club, &c. see करबालिका.

f. (-वी)
The leaf of the Asafoetida plant, Hingupatri: see कवरी and कारवी.

m. (-रः)
1 A fragrant plant, (Oleander or Nerium odorum.)
2 The name of a demon.
3 A sword or scymitar.
4 A [] cemetery, a place for burning or interring the dead.
f. (-रा)
Red arsenic.
(-री)
1 A name of ADITI, the mother of the gods.
2 A good cow.
3 A woman who has borne a son, a mother.
E.
कर here said to mean a root, वीर to become evident, and अच् affix, or कर hand, वि prefixed to ईर to go, &c. affix क.

m. (-कः)
1 A sword.
2 A poison, the poisonous root of the Oleander.
3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

f. (-खा)
A finger.
E.
कर the hand, and शाखा a branch.

m. (-रः)
Water expelled by an elephant's trunk.
E.
कर his trunk, and शीकर drizzling rain.

m. (-कः)
A finger nail.
E.
कर the hand, and शूक the beard of corn.

m. (-थः)
OEdematous swelling of the hands.
E.
कर, and शोथ swelling.

m. (-टः)
1 The fibrous root of a lotus.
2 A tree, (Vangueria spinosa.)
E.
क water, and रह to abandon, करह a lotus, अट what goes, or by what it goes; or कर the hand, हट to illuminate or adorn, and अण् aff.

m. (-कः)
The name of a tree, (Vangueria spinosa.)
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-तः)
A thump, a blow with the hand.
E.
कर, and आघात a blow.

कराम्बुक^1
m. (-कः)
A plant, (Flacourtia cataphracta, Rox.) see कृष्णपाक.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 20260425. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/158.

m. (-कः)
A fruit tree, (Carissa carondas.)

f. (-का)
A bird, a small kind of crane.

n. (-का)
A female crane.

m. (-टः)
A finger ring.
E.
कर the hand, रुट to shine, with आङ् prefixed, affix अच्.

mfn. (-लः-ला-लं)
1 Great, large.
2 High, lofty.
3 Formidable, terrible.
4 Having projecting teeth.
m. (-लः)
Rosin, pitch, or a mixture of oil and the resin of the Śāl tree.
n. (लं)
A dark kind of Tulasī or Basil.
f. (-ला)
A kind of swallow wort, commonly Ananta-mul, (Hemisdemus Indicus). see शारिवा.
f. (-ली)
One of the seven tongues of AGNI or fire.
E.
कर the hand, &c. ला with आङ् prefixed to take, and क affix; or कर, and अल to be able, &c. affix अण्, fem. do टाप् or ङीष्.

m. (-कः)
A sort of Basil, the dark kind.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Having a large trunk, (an elephant.)
2 Having a powerful arm or hand.
E.
कराल, and कर a hand.

mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं)
One who stretches out his hand to support or pick up another, &c.
E.
कर, and अलम्ब what supports.

n. (-नं)
Extending the hand, taking by the hand, helping, sustaining.
E.
कर, and आलम्बन supporting.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Of hideous aspect, ugly, frightful.
f. (-ना)
A form or emanation of DURGA.
E.
कराल, and वदन countenance; also करालानन, करालमुखः, &c.

m. (-कः)
A tree.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Afraid of, alarmed by or at.
2 Rendered formidable.
3 Magnified.
E.
कराल and इतच्.

f. (-ल्ली)
A species of pepper, (Piper chavya.)
E.
करिकण elephant-pepper, वल्ली a vine.

m. (-म्भः)
The frontal globe of an elephant.
E.
करि, and कुम्भ the same.

m. (-म्भः)
A fragrant powder prepared from the flowers of the Nagesar, (Mesua ferrea); also करिकुसुम्भक.

n. (-तं)
The roaring of elephants.
E.
करिन् an elephant, and गर्ज्जित sounding, thundering.

n. (-र्म्म)
An elephant's hide.
E.
करिन्, and चर्म्मन् skin.

m. (-जः)
A young elephant.
E.
करि an elephant, and ज born.

m. (-न्तः)
1 An elephant's tusk.
2 Ivory.
E.
करिन् and दन्त a tooth.

m. (-कः)
A lion.
E.
करि an elephant, दृ to tear or rend, ण्वुल affix; or with युच् affix करिदारण.

m. (-री)
An elephant.
E.
कर the proboscis of this animal, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि)
An actor, acting, doing.
E.
कृ to do, णिनि aff.

f. (-का)
A musical instrument.

f. (-ली)
A plant bearing a pungent fruit, (Pothos officinalis, Rox.)
E.
करि, and पिप्पली long-pepper; Elephantpepper; considered by native writers as a large species of that condiment; also गजपिप्पली, &c.

m. (-तः)
A young elephant, one under ten years old.
E.
करि, and पोत a young animal; also करिशावक.

m. (-न्धः)
The post to which an elephant is tied.
E.
करि, and बन्ध a binding.

m. (-लः)
A lion.
E.
करि, मा splendor, and चल to go; the lion being considered as the natural enemy and destroyer of the elephant.

m. (-खः)
A title of GAṆEŚA.
E.
करि, and मुख a face: this deity being represented with an elephant's head.

n. (-दः)
A water elephant, a hippopotamus.
E.
करि, and यादस् any aquatic animal.

m. (-रः)
The shoot of a bamboo: see करीर.

mn. (-रः-रं)
The shoot of a bamboo; also करिर.
m. (-रः)
1 A thorny plant, described as growing in desarts, and fed upon by camels, commonly Karit, (Capparis aphylla, Rox.)
2 A water jar.
f. (-रा or री)
1 The root of an elephant's tusk.
2 A cricket, a small grasshopper, &c.
E.
कृ to injure, to throw. or send, &c. and ईरण् aff.

m. (-कः)
A young elephant under five years old; according to some, also until ten years.
E.
see करिपोत, शावक meaning a young animal.

mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं)
Doing much.
E.
कर who does, इष्ठन् aff.

mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्)
Doing, (with a future sense,) about to do.
E.
कृ to do, शतृ affix of the future.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
